mapper.select: SELECT S.GRADE_CD, C.CODE_NM AS GRADE_NM, S.BASE_POINT, S.ADD_POINT FROM TB_WELFARE_STD S LEFT JOIN TB_CODE C ON C.GRP_CD = 'GRADE' AND C.CODE = S.GRADE_CD WHERE S.STD_YEAR = #{STD_YEAR} ORDER BY S.GRADE_CD
SELECT REQ_TYPE, LIMIT_AMT FROM TB_WELFARE_LIMIT WHERE STD_YEAR = #{STD_YEAR}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_WELFARE_STD T USING (SELECT #{STD_YEAR} AS STD_YEAR, #{GRADE_CD} AS GRADE_CD FROM DUAL) S ON (T.STD_YEAR = S.STD_YEAR AND T.GRADE_CD = S.GRADE_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.BASE_POINT = #{BASE_POINT}, T.ADD_POINT = #{ADD_POINT} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (STD_YEAR, GRADE_CD, BASE_POINT, ADD_POINT) VALUES (#{STD_YEAR}, #{GRADE_CD}, #{BASE_POINT}, #{ADD_POINT})
